description: This file defines the 'Section4Repository' class in the namespace 'DataAssetBackend.Features.Section4'. It provides data access methods (CRUD operations) for various entities related to section 4, such as site profiles, process streams, chemical materials, SDS, configurations, etc., interacting with a PostgreSQL database using Npgsql. The class includes methods for listing, creating, updating, and soft-deleting entities, with filtering and pagination support. It also contains helper methods for database parameters and reading data models.

classes.name: Section4Repository
classes.description: Repository class providing data access methods for section 4 entities within the application's database context.

methods.name: ListSiteProfilesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of site profiles, optionally filtered by siteId.

methods.name: CreateSiteProfileAsync
methods.description: Creates a new site profile record in the database.

methods.name: UpdateSiteProfileAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing site profile identified by its ID.

methods.name: DeleteSiteProfileAsync
methods.description: Performs a soft delete on a site profile by setting 'is_deleted' to true.

methods.name: ListWwtsProcessStreamsAsync
methods.description: Lists WWTS process streams with optional filtering by siteId.

methods.name: CreateWwtsProcessStreamAsync
methods.description: Creates a new WWTS process stream record.

methods.name: UpdateWwtsProcessStreamAsync
methods.description: Updates a WWTS process stream by its ID.

methods.name: DeleteWwtsProcessStreamAsync
methods.description: Soft deletes a WWTS process stream.

methods.name: ListChemicalRawMaterialsAsync
methods.description: Lists chemical raw materials, optionally filtered by siteId.

methods.name: CreateChemicalRawMaterialAsync
methods.description: Creates a new chemical raw material record.

methods.name: UpdateChemicalRawMaterialAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing chemical raw material by ID.

methods.name: DeleteChemicalRawMaterialAsync
methods.description: Soft deletes a chemical raw material record.

methods.name: ListChemicalSdsAsync
methods.description: Lists chemical SDS entries with optional filtering.

methods.name: CreateChemicalSdsAsync
methods.description: Creates a new chemical SDS record.

methods.name: UpdateChemicalSdsAsync
methods.description: Updates a chemical SDS record by ID.

methods.name: DeleteChemicalSdsAsync
methods.description: Soft deletes a chemical SDS record.

methods.name: ListLabDataConfigurationsAsync
methods.description: Lists lab data configurations, optionally filtered by siteId.

methods.name: CreateLabDataConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Creates a new lab data configuration.

methods.name: UpdateLabDataConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Updates a lab data configuration by its ID.

methods.name: DeleteLabDataConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Soft deletes a lab data configuration.

methods.name: ListWaterProcessConfigurationsAsync
methods.description: Lists water process configurations with optional filtering.

methods.name: CreateWaterProcessConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Creates a new water process configuration.

methods.name: UpdateWaterProcessConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing water process configuration.

methods.name: DeleteWaterProcessConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Soft deletes a water process configuration.
